provenance: Hand-authored synthetic topic facts in scripts/create_semantic_query_fixture.py; labels point to document IDs and exact anchors. No personal files. This is a regression oracle, not a representative relevance benchmark. baseline_supported describes the text-only evaluation harness: long-tail and OCR fixtures are known gaps; media fixtures are unmeasured here even though visual/audio/video embedding exists in the product. Missing groups count as failures in the full denominator.
